entries.claim: The blanket closure marks still-applicable release work as complete, including SECURITY.md/private disclosure and archive-format compatibility decisions, even though removing npm and Windows does not resolve them.
entries.failure_scenario: Terminus remains public OSS with release channels and persistent user archives. Because these unresolved items are now checked off and the publish milestone is declared no longer applicable, a later release can ship without a private vulnerability-reporting channel or an explicit archive compatibility policy, with no open tracker item left to prevent it.

counter_evidence.note: Confirmed and not fixed. D-09 directs closing the whole Publish milestone, so the executor followed the locked decision, but bullets in it such as SECURITY.md and a private disclosure channel, the archive-format compatibility promise across 0.x and the absence of release CI do not depend on npm or Windows. Whether to reopen them is the owner's call.
